facts.big: Is this the right bus…? · How can I get to…?
facts.label: Achar o ônibus certo
facts.sub: Pergunte Is this the right bus for the airport? e How can I get to gate four? Entenda Turn left. Pergunte Do I need exact change? e Can I use my card? Fale sobre How often does the shuttle come?

facts.label: Troco exato
facts.sub: Em ônibus de várias cidades americanas, o motorista não dá troco. Você precisa ter moedas ou notas pequenas na quantia certa. Por isso, muita gente anda com moedinhas na bolsa.

facts.label: Pagar encostando
facts.sub: Cada vez mais ônibus aceitam cartão de transporte ou celular, bastando encostar no leitor. Em algumas cidades, o cartão é vendido em estações e lojas, e você coloca crédito nele.

pages.title: Gate four · 1/3
paragraphs: It is rush hour in Seattle. Nina is in a big transit station with her suitcase. Commuters walk fast in every direction. She wants to go to the airport for her flight. But her bus makes a long detour through the city. She asks the driver, a friendly man named Carl.
“Hi! Where are you going?” says Carl. “Excuse me. Is this the right bus for the airport?” says Nina. “No, this is route twelve. The airport shuttle is at gate four.” says Carl.

pages.title: Gate four · 3/3
paragraphs: “Great. How often does the shuttle come?” says Nina. “Every fifteen minutes. You still have time!” says Carl. Nina learns that she must walk to gate four. She follows the signs and turns left at the machine. At the gate, she sees a blue shuttle with a plane picture. She taps her card on the reader, and a green light comes on. The driver says that the bus leaves in five minutes. Nina smiles and finds a seat by the window.
